summary: Reconciled source registration after research iteration 1. Research 1 read nothing the library did not hold. I re-hashed the PL 26 receipt (it matches the registered remote artifact 0d889bd6), rendered PDF p. 98 again and confirmed both Jerome comments on the image: Matthew 24:36 at col. 181 and 24:42-43 at col. 182. Because the library already holds Jerome's Commentary on Matthew as a segment of that volume, I also bound the reading through that segment (binding 66), with its own deferred row, so that it carries Jerome's work identity and not only the Migne container's. Nothing new was admitted. The drift in the working projection that research 1 reported does not reproduce: the check was current before I regenerated, and the regenerated projection is byte-identical. The handoff, research-preflight, source-library, Catena and family-ledger checks pass, and the make check-sources failure set is the expected one.
